Our switches are all IP40 rated so are perfect for use in harsh conditions, with no forced cooling, and are able to operate in temperatures between -40°C and +75°C. As well as switches we also have a range of rugged SFP modules to compliment the switches. Use our comparison table to take a quick look at the configuration options available within the entire KBC switch line. Managed with PoE Fully managed Layer 2 switches with PoE, dual power input options and configurations of up to 24 ports, including full SFP solutions. View Range Unmanaged with PoE Simple plug-and-play switches supporting PoE, PoE+ and high-power PoE++ up to 90W, with configurations of up to 12 ports available. View Range NEW Unmanaged Plus with Plug-and-play switches with PowerPilot, providing a simple interface for PoE control while keeping network configuration unmanaged. Built on the latest Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, KBC wireless products deliver high-performance wireless Ethernet connectivity for demanding industrial and remote networking applications. Designed for flexibility and ease of deployment, these dual-radio systems operate on license-free 2.4 and 5 GHz bands and support point-to-point, point-to-multipoint, and local access configurations. With throughput up to 2.4 Gbps, rugged IP66-rated construction and intuitive browser-based management, KBC Wireless Ethernet Systems provide a reliable, secure, and scalable solution for extending networks to remote IP devices, infrastructure, and critical operations environments.
